verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at kb.pigment.com that indexes the knowledge base, and markdown versions of the docs (.md) that point to a full documentation index. A marketing-site llms.txt (pigment.com/llms.txt) also exists, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt/markdown docs for agent use, and independent corroboration of agents using them in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://kb.pigment.com/llms.txt # Pigment
